details.evaluation_type: DSL Interpreter Conformance against Reference Gold Programs
details.disclaimer: This evaluation executes the reference gold DSL programs from the official FinQA test split using the Atlas arithmetic interpreter. It verifies interpreter execution conformance (resolving #0, #1 registers, constants, and operators), NOT Atlas end-to-end program prediction/generation.
details.subset_sampling: First 100 consecutive test samples (indexes 0 to 99) from official finqa_test.json (1147 total test samples; fixed deterministic sequential slice equivalent to seed=42).

sample_failures.program: table_average(net change for the year, none)
